name: open_holiday_club_sub_account
description: Open a Holiday Club (S20) sub-account for a member in Meridian CoreSuite with an initial deposit, and return the confirmation number and the new share id.
goal: Sign on to Meridian CoreSuite, look up the member by member number, open the Open Sub-Account form from Member Detail, choose Share Type 'S20 Holiday Club', enter the nickname and the initial deposit, press Open Account, accept the confirmation dialog, and reach the Sub-Account Opened confirmation screen. Read the confirmation number and the new share id.

nickname.description: Nickname for the new sub-account, up to 20 characters

confirmationNumber.description: Confirmation number shown on the Sub-Account Opened screen

shareId.description: Share id assigned to the new sub-account, e.g. S21

secrets.MERIDIAN_USER: Operator ID for the Sign On screen
secrets.MERIDIAN_PASSWORD: Operator password for the Sign On screen

MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.description: No member exists with that member number.

DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM.description: The core rejected the initial deposit as below the product minimum. Nothing was opened.

detect.pattern: Initial Deposit must be at least

FORM_REJECTED.description: The core rejected the form (missing share type, bad amount, nickname too long). Nothing was opened.

detect.pattern: Share Type is required|must be a dollar amount|20 characters or fewer

recoveries.description: The operator session timed out before anything was posted; sign on again and start over.
The core returned an application error page that says the transaction was not completed. Start over.

escalations.description: The operator's role cannot open sub-accounts for this member; a supervisor override is required.
